verdict.rationale: The firm names and describes ChatGD, a homegrown generative-AI chat tool built on an enterprise Azure/OpenAI instance with RAG capability for attorneys — this goes beyond a vague marketing mention by specifying the underlying technology and use case. Additional AI-adjacent tools (D&O Questionnaire Portal, Contract Generator, GDHQ) are also named, showing a pattern of disclosed in-house tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of ChatGD's real-world use, a published AI usage/ethics policy, and more technical depth on data handling or client-facing AI governance.
